label: member of organization
definition: Person, country or organization X is or becomes a member of organization, alliance, party or public body Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit member/belong/membership; join/accession/entry when organizational membership is established; individual legislators and countries in alliances. Excludes: join a person in an action; geographic entry; event participation; party control of legislature; negotiations or proposed membership alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare join without clear completion or membership meaning; plural party naming individual members rather than the party itself.

facts.reason: Brian Cashman → Yankees: Speaking to players, scouts and the team, winning with it and holding a conference at its complex do not establish the particular organizational membership role.
facts.reviewer_question: Does the source identify Brian Cashman as belonging to the Yankees organization, rather than merely addressing or meeting the team?

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.
